_about: Lead-built gold set for the task 054 agentic search eval (docs/tasks/054-toc-integration/agentic-search.md). 2 to 4 decisive studies per link, chosen from a manual search before any arm ran; DOIs verified in OpenAlex on 2026-10-27. 'expected' is the grade band per question that the grade rule should give over this set. Stance is the lead's reading of the abstract. Eval criteria are lead-only: do not edit without the lead.

2fcea71a-290a-4da4-ab12-110c5879e924.label: Ban -> restricted ads absent (compliance)

gold.title: Ofcom (2010) HFSS advertising restrictions: final review
gold.question: here

2fcea71a-290a-4da4-ab12-110c5879e924.note: Regulator monitoring is the main evidence; tests the trusted-publisher web rule (C23).

5635a336-7f75-405d-b888-2200c0f82e4b.label: Restricted ads absent -> children see fewer (critical)
5635a336-7f75-405d-b888-2200c0f82e4b.note: The challenge link: an arm that misses Adams 2012 overstates 'holds here'. Royo-Bordonada 2025 (10.1186/s13690-025-01774-2) is a fair extra challenge.

80c7d89b-a1ca-499e-8759-3203b7662cce.label: Fewer ads seen -> fewer requests
80c7d89b-a1ca-499e-8759-3203b7662cce.note: No peer-reviewed UK study found; CRUK 2018 survey is unverified, so 'here' stays low.

8e2b4385-e314-423e-89f3-cf7e02260c46.label: Fewer requests -> household purchases
8e2b4385-e314-423e-89f3-cf7e02260c46.note: Not separable: the strong designs test ads -> purchases as a bundle. The judge should not credit them fully to this step.

b2eff091-ee50-47dc-a0d7-ad5e02e72d62.label: Fewer ads seen -> fewer snacks (acute)
b2eff091-ee50-47dc-a0d7-ad5e02e72d62.note: The easy link: every arm should get it. A miss here means the pipeline, not the search, is broken.

2018a1e8-af22-4dc5-8056-6d73a01d6f62.label: Lower excess energy -> lower obesity
2018a1e8-af22-4dc5-8056-6d73a01d6f62.note: The motivating link (weak as run). de Ruyter 2012 (10.1056/nejmoa1203034) counts as a decisive find too; James 2007 (10.1136/bmj.39342.571806.55) is the durability challenge.

70e659fa-1c70-407e-891c-ba03fc0de5fb.label: Choosing less healthy food less -> less energy

gold.title: PHE (2018) Calorie reduction: the scope and ambition for action
gold.question: here

70e659fa-1c70-407e-891c-ba03fc0de5fb.note: Tested by descriptive facts (White 2009). The planner should ask for national diet surveys, not trials.

fa4927e3-05b8-4140-8e25-614a43893fe8.label: Failure: marketing shifts elsewhere

gold.title: Department of Health (2008) Changes in food and drink advertising and promotion to children 2003-2007
gold.question: here

fa4927e3-05b8-4140-8e25-614a43893fe8.note: Failure link: 'supports' means evidence that the failure happens.

a2742bca-4313-4849-abc3-9221a423acd1.label: Fewer ads -> foods judged less healthy (thin)
a2742bca-4313-4849-abc3-9221a423acd1.note: Thin: most studies measure liking, not perceived healthiness. An arm that reaches strong here has inflated the grade.

20fe790e-bbb6-4eb3-a7a8-5f94c54c45af.label: Failure: parents still exposed (thin)
20fe790e-bbb6-4eb3-a7a8-5f94c54c45af.note: Thin: no study tests whether parents' exposure cancels the child effect. Expect low grades in every arm.
